claim: Scans .env, Compose, GitHub Actions, and Kubernetes files
sandbox: bundled examples/demo/after directory; assert all four adapter names in JSON

claim: Scans .env and .env.* files for uppercase secret names
sandbox: temporary directory with .env, .env.production, .env.local, ignored invalid names, and an unrelated filename

claim: Scans Compose environment, scalar and list env_file, and short and long service secrets entries
sandbox: temporary Compose project containing every documented form and observable process access

claim: Scans GitHub Actions job env, step env, and reusable workflow secret inheritance
sandbox: temporary workflow with one secret name delivered by each documented form

claim: Scans Kubernetes secretKeyRef, envFrom.secretRef, and mounted secret volumes in Pod templates
sandbox: temporary Deployment with all three secret forms plus ConfigMap controls that must be ignored

claim: Returns exit code 2 when a new process gains a secret name
sandbox: temporary bundled before/after samples plus a negative Compose injection-path refactor using the same secret name and process

claim: Changing how the same secret name reaches the same process is reported without failing the check
sandbox: temporary Compose baseline using environment and current file using a service secret mount for the same API_TOKEN and api process

claim: The check command returns exit code 0 when no process gains a secret name
sandbox: temporary sample project checked against a baseline made from the same files

claim: The diff command reports a new process without a failing exit code
sandbox: temporary directory copied from bundled before and after samples; assert the addition and exit code 0

claim: Invalid input returns exit code 1 with an error
sandbox: unique missing temporary path; assert process status and actionable stderr

claim: Secret values never appear in reports
where: landing page, privacy page, and README
sandbox: bundled .env contains known fake values; assert JSON excludes them and includes names

claim: The --redact option replaces secret names with stable hashes
sandbox: run the bundled sample twice and a temporary injection-path change; assert stable tokens and no raw secret name

claim: The CLI demo uses a new temporary workspace and does not write project data
sandbox: run the bundled demo; assert its output path is under the operating system temp directory

claim: The CLI emits stable JSON for scripts
sandbox: scan the bundled sample with --json and validate schema and edge fields

claim: The CLI has no network or telemetry client and the browser demo makes no third-party requests
where: landing page, privacy page, and README
sandbox: inspect CLI dependencies and capture every request in a fresh browser context

claim: Secret Injection Diff is free and MIT licensed
where: landing page, terms page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context and repository license file

claim: The CLI does not decrypt or store secret values
where: landing page, privacy page, and README
sandbox: scan a temporary dotenv fixture; assert its value is absent from output, the fixture is unchanged, and no output file is created

claim: The CLI writes a baseline only when snapshot is run
sandbox: temporary project; assert scan creates nothing, snapshot creates only the requested baseline, and check/diff create nothing else

claim: The site has no analytics, cookies, accounts, forms, service worker, or browser data storage
sandbox: fresh production build; visit every route and assert no service-worker registrations, Cache Storage, cookies, local/session/IndexedDB, forms, accounts, analytics, or third-party requests

claim: npm run build creates the site in dist/site and the release CLI in dist/bin
sandbox: production build; assert non-empty dist/site/index.html and dist/bin/secret-injection-diff

claim: The CLI does not read secret stores, watch processes, or infer vendor-specific configuration
where: landing page, terms page, and README
sandbox: temporary Vault and SOPS-style YAML; assert no edges, no process/network dependencies, and only documented adapters in source
